svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Screen map B: flow bar
svg.desc: Screen map alternative B: an enlarged flow bar with the eight step screens hanging above and below it, the screens before a plan is open, the launcher, Settings, the user menu and the printed move list.
svg.text: SCREEN MAP · B · BUILT AROUND THE FLOW BAR
Inside a plan the bar never changes. Any step opens at any time;
the check marks only report what is done. Everything else sits around it.
Every step stays clickable; nothing is locked.

g.text: Saved automatically · shared by everyone who logs in
